name: Jessica Martin

This photograph heads the block titled Jessica Martin and the box under it reads vice president of administration, SGA, the office she held that year. Nick Todd, the other candidate, has the mirror block to its right with his own photograph over a box reading vice president of finance. Small at the scan native 150 dpi.
